Field validation must still satisfy <=0.30 m depth mismatch, comparable forcing, substrate/context, wake screening and simultaneous sensor geometry.

Do not relax or retune the frozen 100-m / 12-node / 3-per-bay rules.
No future biological response was used.
The superseded start-point-only result must not be cited as evidence.
